maya: RFC follow-up: propose moving coarse RBAC checks to the dashboard ingress/query gateway and keep fine-grained row-level checks in the executor to reduce backend work and improve panel p95.

sam: High level ok. What are the failure modes we should worry about? leakage, stale caches, UX regressions?

maya: Failure modes: 1) stale ingress auth cache -> over-allow (executor still enforces). 2) ingress false-deny -> missing panels in UI. 3) cache-key explosion if we include dynamic attrs.

lee: Hybrid idea: gateway does tenant+role prefilter and emits a signed permission-hash header. Executor validates signature and re-checks row-level rules. That gives edge filtering while preserving correctness.

olivia: Make sure the hash is derived only from stable attributes (tenant_id, role, feature flags). Avoid ephemeral inputs like session_id or ad-hoc filters to avoid churn.

sam: Caching: use key = query-signature + perm-hash + time-bucket. Otherwise cache results could leak across roles. Short TTL for interactive panels.

maya: Example key: `panel_v1|qsig:SHA256(...)|perm:sha1(role:viewer,tenant:42)|t:60s`.

olivia: Panels with query-dependent row filters (date ranges) remain executor responsibility. Gateway only prefilters on attributes independent of query.

lee: Rollout plan: 1) telemetry-only mode where gateway computes and logs perm-hash header. 2) pilot cache-key on a small set of internal dashboards. 3) prefilter canary for 5% users with auto-disable if missing_panel_rate > 1%. 4) ramp to more users with checks.

sam: Metrics to add: auth.gateway.requests, auth.gateway.false_denies, panel.cache.hit_rate_by_perm, panel.exec.validation_latency, missing_panel_rate per-dashboard, leakage_alert.cross_perm_hits.

olivia: Security: sign the header with ingress key; executor validates to prevent spoofing. Do not log raw perms in prod.

maya: Config snippet example: `rbac.mode = telemetry|prefilter, perm_attrs = [tenant_id, role], canary_pct=5, missing_panel_threshold=0.01, emit_headers=[x-rd-perm-v1]`.

deploy-bot: Created canary template infra/deploys/ingress/rbac-prefilter.yaml and scaffolded telemetry dashboard.

maya: Action items: lee implement perm-hash generator & header contract, sam add telemetry + leakage alerts, olivia run threat model + signing plan, maya draft SRE runbook and rollback triggers.

lee: I'll version the header `x-rd-perm-v1`.

sam: I'll pair on metrics and dashboard PR.

olivia: Scheduling a 30m sync after PRs land to validate instrumentation.

maya: Thanks team — I'll post the RFC follow-up with playbook and canary steps. :thumbsup:
